changelog:
- Initial release of youtube-watcher.
- Fetch and read transcripts from YouTube videos for summarization, Q&A, or content extraction.
- Added support for commands such as "watch youtube", "summarize video", and "video transcript".
- Requires yt-dlp to retrieve transcripts.
- Documentation file (skill-card.md) removed; metadata file added.
summary: Fetch and read transcripts from YouTube videos. Use when you need to summarize a video, answer questions about its content, or extract information from it.
